utfall: grein 4: andel som ikke har fullført bachelor eller 180 studiepoeng innen seks år; menn og innvandrere overrepresentert
gruppe: nye studenter 2002 som ikke har begynt på master
sitat: Of those in the group of students who have not been enrolled in master programmes and who entered HE in 2002, in total 29 per cent have not completed a bachelor programme or attained 180 credit points during the six-years period.

utfall: grein 4: andel uten fullført mastergrad innen seks år; etnisk norske overrepresentert
sitat: Among those who entered higher education in 2002 and who have enrolled into a master programme, 43 per cent had not attained a master degree or equivalent within the six-years period.

utfall: grein 2: andel av hele kullet som har begynt i høyere utdanning innen 2002 (15), 2003 (34) og 2005 (47), dvs. seks år etter start i videregående
sitat: If we look at the oldest cohort (embarked on upper secondary in 1999) only 15 per cent of the total cohort had enrolled into HE in 2002, 34 per cent in 2003 (or earlier) and 47 per cent in 2005 (or earlier) – that is within six years after starting upper secondary education.
